name: Lemoore College curated ingestion manifest
description: Reviewed list of official Lemoore College / West Hills CCD URLs approved for download into the Bedrock Knowledge Base corpus. URLs were taken from the official sitemap and are on approved domains. A human must review and enable each entry before build/upload. Prototype demo — not the official website.

sources.notes: Disabled 2026-07-22: this URL redirects to /admissions/ and returns identical content (exact duplicate). The main Admissions page (kept) covers how future students apply; see its keywords for future-student wording.
Covers graduation petition and common admissions/records questions.

Companion doc. /catalog/current redirects to the college's online catalog system (westhillslemoore.elumenapp.com/catalog/26-27/), an off-approved-domain interactive app the crawler cannot extract. Current edition verified as 2026-2027 from the official redirect target on 2026-07-22. Canonical citation stays on the approved on-domain catalog URL.

companion.body:
## Lemoore College Catalog (2026-2027)

The current Lemoore College catalog is the **2026-2027** edition. It contains degree and certificate requirements, course descriptions, academic policies, and graduation requirements for the 2026-2027 academic year.

The catalog is published in the college's interactive online catalog system. Browse it directly from the official catalog page for the most current program and policy details:

- Official catalog: https://lemoorecollege.edu/catalog/current

Canonical cost/fees source. The tuition-and-fees and net-price-calculator URLs redirect to or are covered by this page; keywords carry the tuition/fees/payment/refund wording so those queries retrieve this page.

Disabled 2026-07-22: this URL redirects to /admissions/cost-of-attendance/ and returns identical content (exact duplicate). Tuition/fee amounts are covered by the retained Cost of Attendance page (see its keywords).

Companion doc. The live page's policy body is JavaScript-rendered (crawler saw an empty shell); the Financial Aid contact, the online Refund Request Form link, and the Net Price Calculator link are in the static page source and were transcribed verbatim. The Refund Request Form (formstack.com) and Net Price Calculator (npc.cccco.edu) are official but off-approved-domain, so they are referenced by name only, never as citation URLs.

companion.body:
## Payment and Refund Request

Tuition and enrollment fees, payments, and refund requests for Lemoore College are handled by the Financial Aid / Business Office. Fee amounts and the full cost of attendance are listed on the official Cost of Attendance page.

**Requesting a refund:** Refund requests are submitted using the official online Refund Request Form linked from the Payment and Refund Request page. The Payment and Refund Policy and a Net Price Calculator are also linked from the official Cost of Attendance page.

**Financial Aid Office**
- Phone: (559) 925-3310
- Email: lemoorefinancialaid@whccd.edu
- Location: 100 Bldg.
- Hours: Monday - Friday, 8:00 am - 5:00 pm

Official pages:
- Payment and Refund Request: https://lemoorecollege.edu/admissions/cost-of-attendance/payment-and-refund-request.php
- Cost of Attendance (fees, payment and refund policy): https://lemoorecollege.edu/admissions/cost-of-attendance/

sources.notes: Disabled 2026-07-22: this on-domain URL returns HTTP 404. The official Net Price Calculator is the California Community Colleges calculator at npc.cccco.edu/582/npcalc.htm, which is off-approved-domain and therefore not ingested per the approved-domain/security policy. It is referenced by name from the retained Payment and Refund Request and Cost of Attendance sources. Reported as a coverage note; no on-domain replacement exists.
Portal help / how to access myWestHills, Canvas, and student email. Public info page only — never crawl the authenticated portal.
Student technology help, including portal/Canvas/student-email password support.

Companion doc. The live Contact Us page body is JavaScript-rendered (crawler saw only nav links). Main phone and address are in the static page source; department phone numbers were verified from the ingested Office Directory page and transcribed verbatim.
